create.title: Global aggregate routing of the endpoint and R1 physical module
create.statement_tex: At fixed finite U,V,S and from one common fixed-w meromorphic antecedent, apply the complete two-axis product Cauchy--Green transfer to all three hierarchical mask shares Theta_beta, Theta_alpha, Theta_o and sum every face, axis, connector, mixed term, collision, and corner before any physical limit. Since sum Theta_kappa=1 and the sums of all first and mixed derivatives vanish after every restriction, all mask connectors cancel. The surviving ordinary unmasked cells form the complete finite Stokes representation of M_fin=sum_{xi in {1,N_X}}D_xi+R_ar[R1], hence equal its original positive-line functional. Taking the already licensed symmetric physical limit only after this exact finite replacement yields normalized O_W(log X), and physical O_W(X^(1/4)log X), with all stars, profiles, floors, chi_4, artificial-pole cancellation, and endpoint conventions preserved. No individual masked or cellwise physical limit is asserted; the finite endpoint-free remainder limit is separate.
create.next_action: Use only in aggregate-before-limit order from the fixed-w antecedent. Do not infer individual masked, face, axis, corner, or off-centred-Perron limits.

create.title: Physical limit of the endpoint-free beta axial remainder
create.statement_tex: Let V_pre_fin be the accepted complete finite pre-limit axial vector and let M_fin be the common endpoint plus recombined R1 arithmetic module. Define the exact finite complement V_ef_fin=V_pre_fin-M_fin using the fixed-w common antecedent and the one-corner/common-residue convention. Prove that after the compact-beta radial-side separation and the prescribed symmetric U,V,S and physical-profile exhaustion, V_ef_fin has a unique limit defining the endpoint-free connector-completed beta axial vector. The limit must preserve all ordinary outside faces, axes, connectors, collision germs, profiles, floors, character factors, and normalization without reintroducing a boundary module. No target-size or terminal-symbol bound is included.
create.next_action: At finite fixed-w contours, write V_ef_fin explicitly and prove or refute its symmetric outside-height and physical-profile limit without estimating the terminal symbol.

update.statement_tex: For the common fixed-w finite endpoint and recombined R1 arithmetic package M_fin, the physical-module interface closes by exact aggregate routing rather than termwise commutation. Apply the complete two-axis transfer to all three hierarchical masks, sum all strata at finite U,V,S, use sum Theta=1 and vanishing first/mixed derivative sums to cancel every mask connector, and retain the ordinary unmasked faces, axes, and corner as the complete finite Stokes representation of M_fin. Return that aggregate to the original positive-line M_fin before taking its already accepted symmetric physical limit. The result is normalized O_W(log X), hence physical O_W(X^(1/4)log X), with all endpoint weights, stars, profiles, floors, chi_4 factors, artificial-pole cancellation, and external normalization preserved. No individual masked-stratum limit or endpoint-free remainder limit is asserted.
update.reason_for_promotion: Blind, discovery, hostile, and conductor derivations agree that the full three-mask finite cell complex exactly reassembles the original positive-line module. This supplies the frozen objective's allowed exact finite algebraic replacement and invokes only the already proved aggregate physical limits.
update.next_action: Treat the endpoint/arithmetic boundary module as globally routed and target-safe; retain all termwise masked limits and the endpoint-free remainder limit as separate open questions.

The proof simplifies the full finite sum before taking the accepted physical limit. No individual masked face, axis, connector, corner, or mask share is shown to converge physically.
After r=w-3/4-v/2, both the real part and endpoints of the r-path move with v. Freezing it omits path-boundary terms; the exact routing requires the original fixed-w meromorphic antecedent.

The finite off-centred Perron kernel has tails and no half tie. Sharp support, product stars, and top half-stars arise only in the licensed symmetric physical inversion after aggregate finite routing.
Artificial cancellation is valid only under common ownership of G=E1+R1 before residue separation. Shifting the displayed R1 summand alone can double count or omit the artificial residue.
Exact removal of M_fin defines V_pre_fin-M_fin at finite height but supplies neither its symmetric outside-height/profile limit nor a limiting endpoint-free axial symbol.
